svg.text: The agent loop of simp-agent — one complete picture
Blocks = steps (numbers = order). Yellow cards = data passed. Grey dashed = from another Part. Purple tags = chapter + code.
Events (Ch06): every block sends small dicts to the subscribers
agent_start · turn_start · message_start / message_update / message_end · tool_execution_start / _update / _end · turn_end · agent_end
Stop button = abort(): sets the cancel flag; the stream closes, the running tool sees ctx.cancel, the run ends with stop_reason "aborted".
Tool approval (ask the human for bash / write / edit) is one before_tool_call (block 6), written in AgentSession → Part 4, Ch13.
